summary: Add a zero-call whole-evaluation input-scope and readiness manifest without changing or removing existing execution paths.
decision_refs: CRIP should reduce unnecessary model input through local transparent page selection
The user should inspect a complete task input plan before separately authorizing provider work
Operational readiness must not be confused with semantic completeness or permission to run
approval_evidence: The active user goal authorizes additive local management and input-reduction features while retaining explicit model-call control and every existing capability.
known_limitations: The manifest reports literal selector results and operational blockers; it does not prove relevance, completeness or engineering precedence.
Source text and evidence IDs are intentionally absent; the existing one-question page preview remains the separate source-inspection path.
Readiness inspection cannot authorize, queue, resume or retry execution.
Offline acceptance does not run or score a stronger model.
